review.housing_signals [judgment] Reconcile heterogeneous housing evidence: reconciliation_needed (unreviewed author policy)

Depends on: dob_bis.11.proposed_dwelling_units, dob_bis.40.existing_dwelling_units, dob_bis.40.proposed_dwelling_units, dob_bis.61.existing_dwelling_units, dob_bis.61.proposed_dwelling_units, dob_bis.62.existing_dwelling_units, dob_bis.62.proposed_dwelling_units, pluto.0.unitsres.

DOB historical existing/proposed units and PLUTO recorded units are different observations. Preserve all positive signals; obtain approved plans, certificates and current-use evidence before concluding occupancy or displacement. No units are summed across filings.

review.next_diligence [judgment] Questions for practitioner review: Review current-use evidence, entitlement pathway, physical constraints and capital structure. (unreviewed author policy)

Depends on: unknown.current_use, unknown.entitlement, unknown.physical_fit, unknown.finance.

A checklist for discussion. Task cost, timing, actor resources and best ordering are not evaluated.

Source limits and terms

- pluto — Tax-lot attributes may lag actual conditions. Zoning fields are recorded descriptors, not a legal entitlement analysis. Zero recorded residential units does not mean vacancy or no displacement. Publisher dataset. Terms.

- dob_bis — Legacy job/document rows, not unique projects or verified current use. Historical existing/proposed units are not current lawful dwellings. Exact-BBL queries miss unlinked filings and historical lot changes. Publisher dataset. Terms.

- dob_now — DOB NOW filing rows are not completed projects or a complete pipeline. Exact-BBL lookup only; missing rows do not establish no activity. Publisher dataset. Terms.

- hpd_violations — Recorded housing violation rows, not occupancy, executed evictions, or a displacement measure. Empty results do not prove no housing, no violations, or a safe building. Publisher dataset. Terms.
